author: BoldAndBrash
body:
**Sorry if you guys are already trying to enforce this! Go ahead and lock if so!**

So a couple minutes ago, there was a MASSSSSIVVE (very big) killfarm going on. The opp team had destroyed our passge so it was suicide :P

THis topic is to discuss ways to keep killfarming balanced. Sorry if youre sick of these topics btw! :d

From what ive seen, staff havent been ding much about this :o

ive seen lots of posts saying killfarming on the bridge in quintus is illegal, yet nothing happens. 

I currently dont have any suggestions , but yall could make some ; )

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body: This would have been a rule, but it would be way too complicated. The problem is, we wouldn't know who team stacked, so a punishment would not work out in that situation. Although we are trying our best for it to stop, by just telling them to make the teams fair, it would still be a repetitive thing that people do.

replies.body:
This is a very hard punishment to deal, mostly because it's hard to identify who to punish, because team stacking is done in groups. 

I witnessed someone team stacking and gave them a warning, so just understand that we ARE trying to deal with this issue. :)

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body: You guys don't understand that this is an impossible rule to enforce.  There are a lot of players who have donated, and the biggest perk (other then the xp boost) is that you can choose which team to be on.  Taking away this perk would be a major mistake.  However, if a staff member sees that a player is joining a stacked player, making it a 5v2 or 10v3 (idk) then that staff member should say something.  But, it shouldn't cause this much attention.  So we should all let it go and let the staff make decide what to do about this.
